newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NORMA TO PAY ONE KROON DIVIDEND.
newsitem.headline: NORMA TO PAY ONE KROON DIVIDEND.

text.p: Industrial group Norma said on Wednesday it will propose to shareholders that it pay dividends worth 13.2 million kroons or one kroon per share for 1996.
The board will propose to shareholders that it retain 50.1 million kroons or the rest of 1996's net profit, which was 63.3 million kroons, the company said in a statement.
Board member Peep Pihatalo said the reason why Norma wants to retain such a sum was for investments and the formation of a capital structure.
"The importance of equity will rise and that of debt fall," he told Reuters.
Norma will invest some 40 million kroons this year, he added. The share holders will also discuss last year results and vote for a new board at the meeting on May 9.
